theme.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY mixed with SWISS BRUTALIST
theme.description: A high-end, cinematic dark mode experience. Designed specifically to make the user's provided background asset and logo the central visual anchors. Heavy emphasis on negative space, deep contrasts, and bold typography.

rules: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.
CRITICAL: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for all headings above 32px.
Never center-align large blocks of text; maintain a strong left alignment for brutalist tension.

palette.accent: Extract dominant color from the provided logo (Fallback: #F3F4F6)

rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Use the provided background asset.
Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG contrast standards.

grid_system.description: Bento-style grid for the project showcase. Goal: Asymmetry and Visual Tension.
grid_system.rules: Base grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero images, col-span-4 row-span-1 for details.

components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10. MUST have background, no transparent headers.
components.hero: Immersive hero relying on the provided background file. CRITICAL: Max overlay opacity bg-black/50 or a gradient overlay to ensure text contrast without killing the image.
components.project_card: Cardless by default. Image with sharp borders, text underneath. Hover state scales image inside a hidden overflow container.
components.form: Shadcn based. Dark flat inputs (bg-white/5), no borders until focus (focus:border-white/30 focus:ring-1).
components.toast: Use Sonner for the confirmation feedback upon form submission.

motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling (Lenis) is MANDATORY to give the portfolio a premium weight.
interactions: Hover states for all interactive elements.
Staggered fade-up entrances for bento grid items.
Subtle parallax on the provided hero background.
rules: Never use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.3s ease).

media.assets_strategy: 1. Scan directory for provided background and logo files. 2. Implement background in Hero. 3. Implement logo in Header and Footer.

instructions_to_main_agent: First, locate the logo and background from the provided zip/files and integrate them.
Build the Hero section using the provided background.
Build the Project Showcase using the provided Unsplash URLs in an asymmetrical grid.
Build the Demo Contact Form using Shadcn primitives. Ensure the form triggers a Sonner toast on submission.
Use Lucide React for minimal, crisp iconography.
Install standard dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge, sonner.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: CRITICAL: Add 'data-testid' attributes to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key interactive elements.
CRITICAL: Avoid 'AI slop'. Do not center-align everything. Use tension, asymmetry, and generous spacing.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the Header. Use glassmorphism.
CRITICAL: NO generic 'SaaS Blue'. Stick to the luxurious dark monochrome palette.
CRITICAL: Never use AI emoji characters.
CRITICAL: Do not use HTML-based components for advanced UI. Use Shadcn + Tailwind.
CRITICAL: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main page structural layout to achieve overlaps, not rigid Shadcn cards.
